protocol.calendar_encoding: 202306=1,...,202411=18; fixed origin; numerical input only when enabled
protocol.cardinality5: Existing integer/spacing type rules are retained; numeric-coded categories with >5 train-only distinct numeric levels become numeric. Text categories and boolean roles are unchanged.
protocol.threshold_selection: One threshold minimizing pooled F7-F9 OOF errors; frozen before F10-F12
protocol.rounds_selection: Median best rounds from F7-F9; no test early stopping
protocol.selection: Six common-parameter conditions first; only CV top two receive 12-trial TPE

limitations: One seed and historically inspected evaluation months; exploratory comparison. Shared unsupervised type map predates this experiment. Actual June-November 2024 labeled data is unavailable. Tree splits do not linearly extrapolate an increasing calendar index.
